decisions.title: Country, currency, tax, fiscal and language scope

workPackages.title: Program status, dependency DAG, evidence and claims register
workPackages.acceptance: All proposals have one accountable owner, no dependency cycles, and evidence is candidate-bound.
workPackages.rollback: Documentation-only; preserve prior register revisions.

workPackages.title: Capability honesty and containment
workPackages.acceptance: Unsupported tender, receipt and offline/device claims are hidden, disabled and technically unreachable.
workPackages.rollback: Independent feature flags; cash online path preserved.

workPackages.title: Uniform POS access and trust controls
workPackages.acceptance: All routes, actions, services, jobs, receipts and replay paths pass negative tenant, entitlement, RBAC and fresh-auth tests.
workPackages.rollback: Observe-to-enforce rollout with approved central gate.

workPackages.title: Physical register boundary and duplicate-data audit
workPackages.acceptance: Boundary is approved and historical conflicts have a non-destructive remediation plan.
workPackages.rollback: Decision and audit only.

workPackages.title: DB active-session invariant and atomic claim
workPackages.acceptance: Concurrent opens produce one winner and a recoverable conflict; forward/backward migration rehearsal passes.
workPackages.rollback: Reversible additive migration; retain session evidence.

workPackages.title: Tender and accounting state machine
workPackages.acceptance: Every enabled tender maps to balanced stock, cash, journal, fiscal, receipt and close effects; unsupported store credit cannot execute.
workPackages.rollback: Tender flags and additive state migration; never erase postings.

workPackages.title: Provider authorization, capture and status contract
workPackages.acceptance: Only authoritative provider evidence permits captured/paid state; retries are idempotent.
workPackages.rollback: Provider kill switch and pending/manual exception state.

workPackages.title: Webhook trust, timeout and late-success recovery
workPackages.acceptance: Signed, replay-protected webhooks and status polling resolve timeout and out-of-order events without duplicate money movement.
workPackages.rollback: Disable inbound/outbound provider operations while retaining immutable evidence.

workPackages.title: Provider reversal and refund lifecycle
workPackages.acceptance: Requested, accepted, settled and failed reversals are distinct, immutable and reconcilable.
workPackages.rollback: Disable automated reversal; preserve controlled manual exception.

workPackages.title: IndexedDB queue and dual-read migration
workPackages.acceptance: Accepted local evidence survives restart and migration, and old queue data remains readable during rollout.
workPackages.rollback: Dual-read fallback and queue export.

workPackages.title: Leases, stale recovery, multi-tab and corruption recovery
workPackages.acceptance: No event remains permanently SYNCING; competing tabs, quota and malformed storage have deterministic recovery.
workPackages.rollback: Disable flush while retaining readable evidence.

workPackages.title: Per-event acknowledgement and terminal retention
workPackages.acceptance: No event is pruned before a mapped terminal replay/reconciliation outcome.
workPackages.rollback: Retain all evidence and disable pruning.

workPackages.title: Offline device signing and key lifecycle
workPackages.acceptance: Forged, expired, revoked, replayed, reordered and cross-tenant evidence is rejected; rotation works.
workPackages.rollback: Shadow verification before approved fail-closed enforcement.

workPackages.title: Canonical exactly-once replay and terminal evidence
workPackages.acceptance: Replay reuses the canonical sale finalizer and duplicates never repeat economic effects.
workPackages.rollback: Pause replay; retain blockers and accepted evidence.

workPackages.title: Offline conflict resolution and close linkage
workPackages.acceptance: Every conflict has owner, permitted action, audit lineage, SLA and terminal outcome.
workPackages.rollback: Read-only evidence workbench remains available.

workPackages.title: Return eligibility and quantity reservation
workPackages.acceptance: Original quantities and prior corrections cap eligibility under concurrent requests.
workPackages.rollback: Disable new corrections; preserve prior evidence.

workPackages.title: Tender-aware correction financial lifecycle
workPackages.acceptance: Cash/provider, stock, journal, fiscal and receipt states remain synchronized or explicitly pending/failed.
workPackages.rollback: Correction kill switch; never erase reversal or journal evidence.

workPackages.title: Supervisor corrections workbench
workPackages.acceptance: Authorized supervisors can explain and recover every correction without overstating completion.
workPackages.rollback: Hide actions while retaining read-only evidence.

workPackages.title: Incremental POS component decomposition
workPackages.acceptance: Behavioral parity holds, service truth remains server-owned, and every slice is independently reversible.
workPackages.rollback: Per-slice component flag or revertible extraction.

workPackages.title: Truthful robust workflow states
workPackages.acceptance: Loading, denied, stale, pending, declined, offline, conflict and retry states preserve cart and provide safe recovery.
workPackages.rollback: Fall back to prior shell without changing server state.

workPackages.title: Scanner, search, cart, customer and tender ergonomics
workPackages.acceptance: Keyboard/touch journeys and declared scan/search/charge budgets pass at target scale.
workPackages.rollback: Feature-flag enhanced interaction paths.

workPackages.title: Hardware adapters, diagnostics and supported matrix
workPackages.acceptance: Readiness derives from actual adapter state; disconnect/reconnect and partial failures are certified.
workPackages.rollback: Disable adapter per device class; manual supported fallback only.

workPackages.title: Receipt delivery and provisional/final proof
workPackages.acceptance: Unavailable channels are hidden; pending is not delivered; retries/revocation/redaction are proven.
workPackages.rollback: Disable channel while public signed receipt/print fallback remains where certified.

workPackages.title: Country-pack money, fiscal and EN/FR localization
workPackages.acceptance: No silent USD or 0.01 fallback; reviewed locale and golden money/rounding/fiscal fixtures pass.
workPackages.rollback: Disable uncertified country pack.

workPackages.title: WCAG, responsive, touch and handheld certification
workPackages.acceptance: Zero critical/serious blockers and complete supported keyboard, screen-reader, zoom/reflow, touch and viewport evidence.
workPackages.rollback: Withdraw unsupported viewport/device claim.

workPackages.title: Provider matching, suspense and settlement certification
workPackages.acceptance: Internal payments, provider events/statements, fees, reversals and journals reconcile or create owned suspense blockers.
workPackages.rollback: Pause automated matching; preserve imported evidence and suspense.

workPackages.title: POS telemetry, SLIs, SLOs, dashboards and alerts
workPackages.acceptance: Every critical state has a low-cardinality measurable SLI, owner, threshold and safe evidence link.
workPackages.rollback: Disable noisy telemetry without disabling core audit evidence.

workPackages.title: Runbooks, support bundles and recovery drills
workPackages.acceptance: Provider, replay, device, fiscal, receipt, drawer, reconciliation and rollback drills pass with named owners.
workPackages.rollback: No promotion until drill blockers close.

workPackages.title: DB, provider, offline and security chaos certification
workPackages.acceptance: Immutable candidate passes declared concurrency, outage, attack, recovery and financial invariant scenarios.
workPackages.rollback: Certification never mutates candidate; failed result blocks promotion.

workPackages.title: Browser, accessibility, hardware and performance field certification
workPackages.acceptance: Every claimed browser/device/country/provider combination has build-bound authenticated field evidence.
workPackages.rollback: Withdraw unsupported claim.

workPackages.title: G1-G8 promotion and claims decision
workPackages.acceptance: All applicable gates PASS; evidence matches exact candidate; risks have owner/expiry; rollback and kill switches are ready.
workPackages.rollback: Reject or withdraw promotion; do not waive mandatory failures.

workPackages.title: Certified handheld, analytics and advisory differentiation
workPackages.acceptance: Each new capability is separately scoped, implemented by a bounded specialist and re-certified.
workPackages.rollback: Disable differentiated capability independently.

holdPoints.condition: G1/G2/G5 design contracts approved before provider or offline implementation
No electronic-payment production claim without provider and reconciliation proof
Offline selling remains disabled until G3 and G4 independently pass
